findings.details: Changed from hardcoded 'helpers/' path to recursive grep (-r). Validates correctly across actual directory structure.
Case-insensitive pattern matching for CLAUDE.md text. Pattern 'grep.*over.*find' matches actual documentation phrasing.
Relaxed validation checks for spawn-agent mechanism OR file existence. More resilient than hardcoded string matching, but message clarity could improve.
OR logic handles multiple valid states (.sh.backup files, bash-wrappers, data directory). Correctly validates against cfn-redis-coordination structure.
